response.overview: After winning the 1982 Wimbledon and US Open Junior titles at 17, Zina Garrison soared to a World No. 1 ranking. Her success was forged in struggle, battling self-doubt and financial hardship, all while concealing a deeply personal truth.
response.tagline: “Without Zina, there would be no Venus, there would be no Serena, there would be no Sloane Stevens, there would be no Coco Gauff...”
response.title: Zina
